An SAE is a translation layer, turning a model’s activations into a list of human-readable concepts (features). This lets you “read the mind” of a model at any given point.

E.g., an SAE might show “French”, “legal contracts”, and “polite refusal” are active as a model is

SAEs are:
- unsupervised
- scalable
- relatively unopinionated, but not assumption-free
- missing feature labels by default (that requires an auto-interp pipeline)
